input.subject: Great news from Fabrikam
input.body:
Hi Alex,

Following our call today, I'm delighted to confirm that we'd like to offer you the Senior DevOps Engineer role.
You'll receive the formal offer letter tomorrow. Let me know if you have questions in the meantime.

Grace

input.subject: Your offer from Relecloud
input.body:
Dear Alex,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Solutions Architect at Relecloud, with a start date of January 4, 2027.
Please review the attached offer letter and sign it by November 6, 2026 to accept.

Welcome aboard,
Relecloud People Team

input.subject: Re: Offer details
input.body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your note. We can increase the signing bonus as discussed; the rest of the offer for the Mobile Engineer role stays the same.
An updated offer letter is attached.

Mina
